$comment: Shared contract for flow-from-object YAML serialization (PR #459).
Kestra's server reads flow source with Jackson's YAMLParser (JacksonMapper.ofYaml()),
a YAML 1.1 reader. Every SDK's flow-to-YAML serializer (Go flow_yaml.go, Python
flow_yaml.py, JS flow-from-object.ts, Java FlowsApi) must emit each `mustQuote` string
as a QUOTED scalar (as a map value and as a map key) so it round-trips as the exact
string, and must leave each `staysPlain` string as a plain scalar. Every SDK's tests
assert against THIS file so the four hand-written predicates cannot drift: add a case
here, not to one SDK's test.
